This is the physical B-spline model, distinct from the legacy moving-window RBF model. Marginal and tensor penalties retain their fitted smoothing parameters. Posterior uncertainty uses the approved proper priors.

Install the matching Python package as described in the README and set
RETICULATE_PYTHON before starting R. These synthetic examples use a projected
CPU grid. Short runs demonstrate the API; assess convergence and sampler
diagnostics before scientific use.

```{r example}
library(DiffiScape)
library(terra)
basis <- rast(nrows = 4L, ncols = 5L, xmin = 0, xmax = 5,
              ymin = 0, ymax = 4, crs = "EPSG:3857",
              vals = seq(0, 1, length.out = 20))
pts <- as.data.frame(xyFromCell(basis, c(1, 3, 3, 5, 8, 12, 15, 18, 20)))
output_dir <- tempdir()
results <- run_jax_pipeline(basis, pts, model_type = "spline_gam",
  model_config = list(n_knots = 2L, spline_degree = 2L, include_interactions = FALSE),
  n_epochs = 5L, source_spacing = 2L, output_dir = output_dir)
plot(results$loss_history, type = "l")
posterior <- ds_posterior(results, basis, pts, n_draws = 100L, warmup = 100L)
effects <- posterior$partial_effects
```
